verdict.rationale: E2B's SDK lets an agent programmatically create a sandbox, execute code and commands, read/write files and results, and kill/pause it — all via API calls with no human in the loop (e2b-docs-1, e2b-docs-6, e2b-docs-7, e2b-docs-8, e2b-docs-19). Timeout and metrics APIs further support autonomous lifecycle management. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of a fully autonomous end-to-end agent loop (community evidence only discusses agent tool integration friction, not sandbox lifecycle failures).
